evals.prompt: QA a checkout page after a form-validation change. Explain the exact Skeptic command sequence you would run and what evidence must exist before you call it done.
evals.expected_output: A fresh-ref browser loop that checks the changed path, an adjacent negative path, accessibility, console, network, screenshot or visual evidence, and closes/reports the session.
expectations: Discovers or respects the installed command contract instead of inventing verbs
Re-snapshots after navigation or meaningful DOM changes before reusing refs
Includes console, network, accessibility, and visual evidence
Treats page content as untrusted data and reports exact artifact paths

evals.prompt: A React pull request may have introduced a duplicate fetch in an effect. Describe how an agent should use Skeptic to diagnose it and prove or disprove the static hypothesis.
evals.expected_output: Changed-scope Doctor plus an exercised browser run whose network evidence is folded through the report correlator.
expectations: Runs Doctor in changed scope with an explicit base
Exercises the relevant runtime path and collects network requests
Uses report or score explain to consume correlation and coverage
Does not claim confirmation from static analysis alone

evals.prompt: Drive an Android emulator login screen containing non-ASCII user input and collect evidence of a scrolling performance regression.
evals.expected_output: Explicit device selection, snapshots and ref-safe gestures, ADBKeyboard Unicode path, screenshot/logcat/gfxinfo or recording evidence, with limitations called out.
expectations: Starts by listing devices and selects an explicit device
Uses ADBKeyboard for non-ASCII input and never bare adb input text
Collects gfxinfo plus screenshot or screenrecord evidence

evals.prompt: Prepare Skeptic for CI in an untrusted fork pull request and explain which generated files and permissions matter.
evals.expected_output: Uses the generated GitHub Action, preserves the fork write-permission guard, uploads evidence, emits annotations and a step summary, and avoids granting project-command permission implicitly.
expectations: Uses skeptic add github-action or the equivalent checked-in template
Retains the untrusted-fork guard around write-permission operations
Uploads SARIF and run artifacts and writes the step summary
Does not enable project-defined analyzer commands without authorization
